# ProIT365 MultiKey Auth

ProIT365 MultiKey Auth (MKAP) is an initial-development multi-key
challenge-response authentication protocol and ecosystem for API requests.

Repository: https://github.com/proit365/multikey-auth
Publisher: https://proit365.com

## Implemented repository content

- MKAP v1 protocol specification
- PHP cryptographic core
- PHP key pool and lifecycle implementation
- AES-256-GCM server-side secret storage
- PDO and mysqli key repository adapters
- SQLite and MySQL migrations
- Framework-independent challenge issuer and verifier
- PHP client SDK
- Laravel 12 server package
- Laravel 12 client package
- Server-side JavaScript/Node.js SDK
- Dart/Flutter SDK
- Administrative CLI
- Documentation and security limitations

## Security status

MKAP is custom authentication protocol material under development. It has not
received an independent security review and is not production-ready. A
complete client export compromise permits impersonation. Browser JavaScript
must not hold a complete secret pool.
Published/live package testing is development verification, not production
certification.
